page.layout: One page of text in a single column, with the running head centred at the top and the page number at the top right. Below the text is a catchword at the lower right. No marginal notes are printed.

main_text.p: VI. Ab exemplo Davidis non fugientis 2.Sa. 14: item Christianorum graßante lue manentium & officia gentilibus praestantium. Euseb.l.3. c.8. Videatur locus in hist. Ecclef.
Conclusio: Cum pestis propter peccata infligatur, fuga peccatorum & resipiscentia potius quam secessione avertenda videtur: Et repetatur petitio.
main_text.head: Exercitatio XLIX. De fuga pestis.
RESPONSIO.
main_text.p: EXordium ab αἰτιολογία[?], cur hactenus non re-sponderis: quia lue Dei gratia depulsa puta-veris sepeliendum hoc argumentum: & cur nunc respondeas: 1. quia ipse urgeat. 2. quia hesternum funus amici in fuga luis defuncti te huius commonefecerit.(D. Johannes Posthius Archiater Palatinus cum augusto Senatu luis causa secesserat Mosbacum: sed ibidem non peste sed podagra & catarrhis exstinctus, Heidelbergam reductus atque humatus fuit 26. Junii.97.)
Transitio: Te igitur paucis expositurum tuam de fuga pestis sententiam salvo meliore aliorum judicio.
Partitio: Fugere pestem res est per semedia[?]: ex circumstantiis seu accidenti fit aliis illicita, a-liis licita: Sed nullis admodum expedions.

page.notes: Greek word after "EXordium ab" is uncertain and marked [?]; it reads like αἰτιολογία. The word after "Subiiciatur" is also uncertain (ἔκθεσις?). "semedia" is doubtful (possibly "medias" with a long s), marked [?]. "expedions" is probably a printing error for "expediens", left as printed. The catchword "Proposi-" is at the lower right. The faint mirrored text (show-through) on the right of the page is not transcribed. The first two lines at the top of the column are set as separate paragraphs.
